standard_prerequisites.name: Exactness of sheafification and the constant sheaf functor
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Sites, section on sheaves on a site (constant sheaves and exactness of sheafification)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives exactness as sheaves and identifies the constant sheaf construction.

core_obligations: Use exactness of sheafification to conclude that the constant sheaves form a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves, and hence that the sequence is exact at the first two spots as presheaves (proof lines 8424-8428).

To obtain surjectivity of the map of presheaves, choose a set-theoretic section s : C -> B of the group surjection and observe that it induces a map of constant sheaves left inverse to the surjection (proof lines 8429-8434).
Conclude that the sequence of constant sheaves is exact as a sequence of abelian presheaves.
proof_roadmap: Get exactness as sheaves from exactness of sheafification.
Produce presheaf surjectivity by a set-theoretic section.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that applying the constant sheaf functor to a short exact sequence of abelian groups yields a sequence that is exact as sheaves and even as presheaves. Exactness at the first two spots and injectivity follow from exactness of sheafification together with the fact that the presheaf kernel coincides with the sheaf kernel in this situation; the remaining point, surjectivity of the constant sheaf of the quotient, is proved by choosing a set-theoretic section of the surjection and observing that it induces a section of the map of constant sheaves left inverse to the surjection (proof lines 8423-8434). H2: the set-theoretic section argument that produces presheaf surjectivity is the substance.
